GRADE 8 CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — MOCK EXAM

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Time: 80 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. This mock paper follows CBC assessment style.
2. Answer all questions.
3. Manage your time carefully.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Roles of Creative Arts and Sports at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the roles of Creative Arts and Sports in society,
   B. Learners should ignore Roles of Creative Arts and Sports completely.
   C. Roles of Creative Arts and Sports is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.

2. About Roles of Creative Arts and Sports at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. make a storyboard highlighting the roles of Creative Arts and Sports in society,
   B. Learners should ignore Roles of Creative Arts and Sports completely.
   C. Roles of Creative Arts and Sports is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.

3. About Roles of Creative Arts and Sports when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the roles of Creative Arts and Sports in society,
   B. Learners should ignore Roles of Creative Arts and Sports completely.
   C. Roles of Creative Arts and Sports is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.

5. About Components of Creative Arts and Sports at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. describe elements of Verse,
   B. Learners should ignore Components of Creative Arts and Sports completely.
   C. Components of Creative Arts and Sports is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

6. About Components of Creative Arts and Sports at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. perform activities that enhance endurance and agility in physical fitness,
   B. Learners should ignore Components of Creative Arts and Sports completely.
   C. Components of Creative Arts and Sports is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

7. About Components of Creative Arts and Sports when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. write note values on the bass staff,
   B. Learners should ignore Components of Creative Arts and Sports completely.
   C. Components of Creative Arts and Sports is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

9. About Drawing and Painting at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. discuss dominance in a picture,
   B. Learners should ignore Drawing and Painting completely.
   C. Drawing and Painting is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Drawing and Painting.

10. About Drawing and Painting at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. classify complementary colours on a colour wheel,
   B. Learners should ignore Drawing and Painting completely.
   C. Drawing and Painting is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Drawing and Painting.

11. About Drawing and Painting when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. illustrate a colour gradation strip to show colour contrast,
   B. Learners should ignore Drawing and Painting completely.
   C. Drawing and Painting is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Drawing and Painting.

13. About Kenyan Folk Dance at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. classify folk dances from Kenyan communities,
   B. Learners should ignore Kenyan Folk Dance completely.
   C. Kenyan Folk Dance is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kenyan Folk Dance.

14. About Kenyan Folk Dance at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. perform a folk dance from a Kenyan community,
   B. Learners should ignore Kenyan Folk Dance completely.
   C. Kenyan Folk Dance is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kenyan Folk Dance.

15. About Kenyan Folk Dance when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. classify folk dances from Kenyan communities,
   B. Learners should ignore Kenyan Folk Dance completely.
   C. Kenyan Folk Dance is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kenyan Folk Dance.

17. About Indigenous Kenyan Craft at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. identify basketry items made using coil techniques,
   B. Learners should ignore Indigenous Kenyan Craft completely.
   C. Indigenous Kenyan Craft is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft.

18. About Indigenous Kenyan Craft at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. make a basketry item using the coil method,
   B. Learners should ignore Indigenous Kenyan Craft completely.
   C. Indigenous Kenyan Craft is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft.

19. About Indigenous Kenyan Craft when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. identify basketry items made using coil techniques,
   B. Learners should ignore Indigenous Kenyan Craft completely.
   C. Indigenous Kenyan Craft is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft.

21. About Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy completely.
   C. Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.

22. About Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy completely.
   C. Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.

23. About Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy completely.
   C. Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.

25. About Swimming at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the inverted breaststroke and water treading technique in swimming,
   B. Learners should ignore Swimming completely.
   C. Swimming is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Swimming.

26. About Swimming at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. perform water treading skill in swimming,
   B. Learners should ignore Swimming completely.
   C. Swimming is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Swimming.

27. About Swimming when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. perform the inverted breaststroke technique in swimming for skill acquisition,
   B. Learners should ignore Swimming completely.
   C. Swimming is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Swimming.

29. About Kenyan Indigenous Games at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Kenyan Indigenous Games using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Kenyan Indigenous Games completely.
   C. Kenyan Indigenous Games is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kenyan Indigenous Games.

30. About Kenyan Indigenous Games at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Kenyan Indigenous Games completely.
   C. Kenyan Indigenous Games is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kenyan Indigenous Games.

31. About Kenyan Indigenous Games when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. Kenyan Indigenous Games helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Kenyan Indigenous Games completely.
   C. Kenyan Indigenous Games is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Kenyan Indigenous Games.

33. About Rhythm at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. describe 3 4 time in music,
   B. Learners should ignore Rhythm completely.
   C. Rhythm is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Rhythm.

34. About Rhythm at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. compose a four-bar rhythmic pattern in 3 4 time,
   B. Learners should ignore Rhythm completely.
   C. Rhythm is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Rhythm.

35. About Rhythm when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. perform four-bar rhythmic patterns in 3 4 time,
   B. Learners should ignore Rhythm completely.
   C. Rhythm is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Rhythm.

37. About Middle Distance Races and Montage at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. describe middle distance races in athletics,
   B. Learners should ignore Middle Distance Races and Montage completely.
   C. Middle Distance Races and Montage is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Middle Distance Races and Montage.

38. About Middle Distance Races and Montage at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. perform middle distance races for skill acquisition,
   B. Learners should ignore Middle Distance Races and Montage completely.
   C. Middle Distance Races and Montage is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Middle Distance Races and Montage.

39. About Middle Distance Races and Montage when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. discuss characteristics of a montage composition,
   B. Learners should ignore Middle Distance Races and Montage completely.
   C. Middle Distance Races and Montage is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Middle Distance Races and Montage.

36. Give two examples of how you can use Rhythm at home with your family.
